title: Adaptive Cruise Control System
text: Simulate adaptive cruise control using model predictive controller, 9 inputs, 1 output, {Linear model from longitudinal acceleration to longitudinal velocity} sets Ego vehicle model; {Initial condition for longitudinal velocity} sets the initial velocity of the ego vehicle model, {Default spacing} sets the minimum spacing to lead vehicle, {Maximum velocity} sets the maximum longitudinal velocity, {Minimum longitudinal acceleration} sets the minimum ego vehicle acceleration, {Maximum longitudinal acceleration} sets the maximum ego vehicle acceleration, {Sample time} sets the controller sample time, {Prediction horizon} sets the controller prediction horizon, {Controller behavior} sets the closed-loop controller performance, {Use suboptimal solution} applies suboptimal solution after specified number, {Maximum iteration number} sets the maximum optimization iterations, {Use external signal to enable or disable optimization} adds port for enabling optimization, {Use external signal for bumpless transfer between ACC and other controllers} adds external control signal input port and {Create ACC subsystem} sets the create custom controller. Values come from the instance.
